references: SEGA official Saturn family overview, HST-3210 dimensions only
Dig and Rescue firsthand HST-3200 front/top and rear interface detail
findings: Rear inlet plate now has the photographed descending stem and lower-left fixing in a rear view.
Rear AV sleeve and cable have paired orientation keys and a lower flat stop.
Estimated inner overlap lip masks the former bright case seam while retaining side vents, front ports and service-cover clearance.
Original grey shell, sloped shoulders, disc-lid/front-control arrangement and left-side rear service cover are retained.
limitations: The official family dimensions describe HST-3210; this HST-3200 envelope is an approximation.
Local side/front vent spacing, graphic marks, moulded curves and internal mechanisms are not verified factory dimensions.
Mini-DIN contact positions, C8 pin diameter and matched controller study pitch remain estimates.
